posts.title: Winx Club Costume Party mini cards arrive November 11
posts.summary: KAYOU's new Winx Club mini set has 45 cards in 8 rarities, plus 3 promos. It's already on My Pretty Pulls, ready to track.
posts.body:
Winx Club **Costume Party** is KAYOU's first Winx Club mini series, and it comes out on November 11, 2026.

## What's in the set
- 45 cards in 8 rarities, numbered WCP01
- ZR, GP, AR, UGR, UR and SR: one of each Winx fairy
- FR: each fairy with her Specialist
- SSR: the Trix (Stormy, Icy and Darcy)
- 3 promo cards: buy 1 box and get 1 PR card free

!![KAYOU's product sheet for Winx Club Costume Party. Tap to see it full size.](/content/news/winx-costume-party-info.webp)

## Track it
The whole set is already in your Winx Club binder. Card pictures will be added as soon as KAYOU posts them. [Open the Winx Club collection](/)

posts.title: KPop Demon Hunters World Tour Series 2 is here
posts.summary: Series 2 brings 178 cards: 111 in the Classic Edition and 142 in the Energy Edition, with retro pixel art, double-sided tarot cards and mini-CD cards.
posts.body:
KAYOU's **World Tour Series 2** for KPop Demon Hunters is out, in a Classic Edition and an Energy Edition.

## New looks
- Retro pixel art
- Holographic fashion
- Double-sided tarot cards
- Mini-CD cards
- Titan Rare (TR) comes to the Classic Edition for the first time

## Good to know
- Classic Edition: 111 cards in 8 rarities (R, SR, SSR, QR, TR, UR, ZR and CR)
- Energy Edition: 142 cards in 11 rarities (SR, SSR, HR, QR, TR, UR, LR, SP, ◇CR, BP and SE)
- Many cards are in both editions, so there are 178 different cards in all
- Buy 1 box of either edition and get 1 PR card free
- 20 packs per box, 24 boxes per case
- Scenario-E, Brush Rare and Creative Rare Parallel cards are serialized: you can save the number on your copy in its card window

## Energy Edition

!![KAYOU's product sheet for the Energy Edition. Tap to see it full size.](/content/news/kpdh-s2-energy-info.webp)

## Classic Edition

!![KAYOU's product sheet for the Classic Edition. Tap to see it full size.](/content/news/kpdh-s2-classic-info.webp)

All 178 cards are on the site with their real pictures. [Open the KPop Demon Hunters collection](/kpop-demon-hunters)
